info.name: MISE - Authentication API
info.description: Manual integration tests for MISE backend. Start MySQL, Redis and Express. Set a new email address you control in the collection Variables tab. Keep values local and do not share actual tokens or emails. Send numbered requests in sequence, entering the two actual OTPs manually. Run steps 19 and 20 within the access token lifetime (15 minutes by default); a TOKEN_EXPIRED response instead of INVALID_SESSION does not demonstrate revocation. Optional resend is run before verification only. Tests create a persistent account, workspace and sessions. Do not run against production. Rate limiting can affect repeated runs. No live credentials included.

request.description: Set email to an unused address you control before sending. Generates a fresh username and clears previous test credentials. Creates persistent test records.
